contact.faq1q: How do I book an appointment?
contact.faq1a: Simply create an account, browse our doctors directory, and click "Book Appointment" on any available doctor. You can also book directly from your dashboard.
contact.faq2q: Can I cancel or reschedule my appointment?
contact.faq2a: Yes, you can manage your appointments from your dashboard. Cancellations and reschedules are free up to 24 hours before your appointment.
contact.faq3a: Absolutely. We use enterprise-grade encryption and comply with data protection regulations to ensure your medical data is always protected.
contact.faq4a: We work with most major insurance providers including Star Health, ICICI Lombard, HDFC Ergo, and more. You can verify your coverage during booking.
contact.faq5q: How do I contact my doctor after a visit?
contact.faq5a: After your appointment, you can send follow-up messages through your dashboard. Your doctor will respond within 1-2 business days.
